title: How should the check handle a question an agent words its own way?
context: Evals: the check never ran in 26 of 60 question-opening runs, mainly because agents reworded the question and the word match found nothing. On past data, reworded titles scored 0.00 to 0.31 against the 0.5 floor, so word matching cannot detect meaning. A wider floor of 0.3 fires on 44 percent of questions and still misses most rewordings. Within runs where the check ran: 0 wrong suggestions.
